paragraphs.text: [softly] Dick made the sign of the cross over the beach before he left -- a small, private benediction that no one saw or, if they saw, did not understand. It was the gesture of a priest consecrating ground he will never visit again, and it contained within it all the tenderness and all the loss that the word goodbye is too small to hold.
